title: Deviation
description: assessments/<id>/deviations.jsonl entries -- engineering plan section 9.3. Deviations are separate immutable annotations; they never modify the underlying technical status. Reports render 'Fail -- Approved Deviation' when applicable. Expired or scope-mismatched approvals have no effect.

objectScope.description: Must exactly match a ControlResult's scope field for this deviation to apply -- a deviation approved for one object never silently covers another (scope-mismatched approvals have no effect, per section 9.3).

expiryDate.description: Required, not optional -- there is no such thing as a permanent deviation in this schema. An expired deviation has no effect (section 9.3), enforced at read time, not by this schema.

compensatingControl.description: Explicit null when no compensating control is claimed.

evidence.description: References/citations supporting the justification. Empty array, not absent, when none were attached.
